The '''Eol Sha system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eol Sha]].
